title: Universal Pickleball Anthem - G4 Clean
style: cinematic phonk, gospel choir stabs, soul blues organ, heavy 808 sub-bass, cowbell accents, chopped vocal chops, Spanish crowd chants, Mandarin chant snippets, stadium claps, 142 BPM, punchy kick, distorted snare, analog tape saturation, wide master bus, bright major-key brass, string staccato hits, halftime drop, anthem hook, dark lyric bright groove
lyrics:
[Intro]
The court is calling... every player hears it...
Wind in your favor... timeless...

[Verse]
Power in the fire, speed in the flame...
When every shot says none is right...
We still smash... smash... smash!

[Pre-Drop]
¡Vamos! ¡SMASH!

[Drop]
SMASH IT! SMASH IT!
Go for it, the time is right now!
Sooooo... SMASH IT!

[Mandarin]
加油! 力量! 永远!

[Final]
We in overdrive... ¡Vamos!
Pickleball forever... 永远!
SMASH IT! 加油! 力量!

[Outro]
Pickleball... forever...
